name: overview
description: Usage limits under the prompt, an Overview pane of sessions, workers, subagents and where tokens went, a reflection band after each turn and an on-demand heads-up check.

headsUp.title: Heads-up checks
headsUp.description: manual: only when you press Heads-up or run /coach heads-up (no tokens otherwise); auto: also after a long turn (10+ tool calls), at most every 10 minutes. Each check is one model request.
